manifest.stoppingRule: Complete all prespecified fixtures and arms, retain every outcome; no outcome-based tuning or stopping.
manifest.seedPolicy: Matched seeds across arms; side-balanced independent trials. Divergent decisions can desynchronize later draws.
manifest.replayPolicy: Full replay of first fixture of each profile/arm; every saved result replays on resumption. Frozen v1.0 control checked for first fixture per profile.
manifest.interpretation: Synthetic mirror-roster shared-psychology study; home support only in explicitly named arms. Weather, temperature traits and halftime adaptation absent. No official histories.

analysisPlan.primaryContrast: shared-full-5 minus control focal win probability on the same fixtures
analysisPlan.primaryInterval: Paired mean difference +/- 1.96 estimated standard errors; large-sample approximation
analysisPlan.precisionDesign: Exploratory screening followed by fixed fresh-seed confirmation; not a certification that the true psychological lift is below four points.
analysisPlan.decisionPolicy: No coefficient changes or outcome-dependent stopping. Direction supported only if the primary 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise report unresolved direction, not equivalence or an engine bug.

manifest.thresholds: Report observed effects and uncertainty; no result-dependent stopping or adopted-coefficient decision.

diagnosis: Root playing/elapsed duration fields disagreed with the final event; all scores, events, quarters and player/team statistics matched the neutralized condition. The bad root durations matched the next condition in a standalone reproduction. This suggests return-object retention/runtime behavior, but the underlying cause is not established. Diagnostic instrumentation changed reproducibility; no engine-runtime defect is claimed.
remedy: Detach each result immediately through JSON serialization, freeze its root, check root clocks against the final event and quarter playing totals, and re-audit retained results before saving. Preserve this aborted sample; restart under fresh IDs without changing coefficients.
